title: Your First Sunday | Kingdom Life

implementation.values: Bounded 18px / opacity .75 image entry over 700ms, or 2px clarity entry over 650ms. Reconstruction estimates; source editor values unavailable. Once-entry; normal reverse scroll. No pinning.
implementation.deviation: Motion is estimated rather than exact editor reconstruction. No invented pairwise axis distinctions. Every element remains visible before script. Desktop arrival introduction remains sticky beside normal-flow steps; mobile uses normal flow. This is a content-preserving adaptation of the observed Royal paired-story relationship, not an exact recreation of its image swap.
deleted: Legacy texture-only source backgrounds omitted where they conflicted with the locked identity; asset files retained.
No automatic decorative arrows or icon badges.
